Hi Alex —

Great to meet you earlier — thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise post-call recap and proposed next steps.

Post-call recap (high level):
- SOC 2: Redwood is currently SOC 2 Type II in progress; we completed Type I in Q4 2026. Type II audit is expected to be completed and certified by Q3 2027. We can share the Type I report now and Type II readout once finalized. (Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf)
- GDPR / HIPAA: We provide a standard Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and a HIPAA BAA for customers with covered workloads. We can share templates and customer-facing language for legal review.
- Audit logging (summary):
  - Admin activity logs: capture console/admin UI actions (user creation, role/permission changes, config updates).
  - API request logs: request metadata (request id, timestamp, caller identity, model, input size, response latency). PII is not stored in logs by default — payload redaction/configurable.
  - Exportability: logs can be exported to customer S3 buckets or pulled via secure API; we support JSON and CSV exports.
  - Immutability / WORM: we support write-once export to customer-managed S3 with Object Lock for WORM; internally, logs are append-only with strict retention controls and tamper-evident checksums.
  - Retention & deletion controls: retention configurable per-account; default retention is 90 days for API logs and 1 year for admin activity unless otherwise specified by contract.
  - SIEM integration: native S3 export + Kinesis Firehose integration; customers typically ingest into Splunk/Datadog via S3 or direct HTTP forwarding.

Attachments included: audit-logging-overview.pdf (detailed fields/timestamps), sample-log-extract.json (redacted sample).

Proposed next steps:
1) I can start the vendor security questionnaire flow — I uploaded a starter packet and question mapping here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD-example-questionnaire. If you prefer the full questionnaire (read-only), tell me which format and I'll push it directly.
2) If your infra team wants a technical deep-dive on immutability and SIEM ingestion, Aditya (cc'd) can join a 45-min call. Please propose 2-3 times.
3) We'll provide the Type I SOC 2 report and the DPA/BAA templates for legal review.

Let me know which of the above you'd like to prioritize and we'll action.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

- Immutability: when you say "internal append-only with tamper-evident checksums," can you confirm whether customers can retain a cryptographic proof or signed hash for logs exported to our S3 to independently verify no changes? We need strong attestations for our audit.
- Sample log extract: the sample looks good but can you provide a small (redacted) extract that includes admin role-change event and API request metadata for traceability?
- Retention: our baseline requirement is 7 years for certain audit records. Is long-term cold archival supported and what is the cost model?

If you can start the vendor questionnaire in parallel, please set it to read-only for us. We'll converge on legal items after we have the SOC 2 Type I report and the DPA/BAA templates.

Also, we prefer a technical call on Thursday 5/20 at 10:00am PT if that works for Aditya.

Alex

Alex —

Perfect — we can absolutely support those asks. Quick replies and actions: 

- Cryptographic proof: yes. When exporting logs to a customer-managed S3 bucket we can include signed manifests (SHA-256) that are signed by our key and optionally by a customer-shared key for stronger non-repudiation. We'll include documentation on verifying the manifests.
- Sample extract: attached sample-log-extract.json is a redacted set containing an admin role-change event and an API request with trace id and timestamps.
- Long-term archival: we support exporting to customer S3 with lifecycle rules for Glacier/Deep Archive. We don't enforce archival pricing — customers pay their cloud storage costs; Redwood can push daily exports to your bucket. We can also provide a managed-archival add-on for long-term retention if you prefer Redwood-managed cold storage (quote-based).

I've initiated the vendor questionnaire as a read-only shared doc and added the Acme Security team. Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD-example-questionnaire (same as above).

Aditya — can you confirm availability for the technical deep-dive Thursday 2027-05-20 at 10:00am PT? If not, propose an alternate.

Next steps (summary):
- Marissa to send SOC 2 Type I report + DPA/BAA templates (target: EOD 5/17).
- Aditya to run technical deep-dive (target: 5/20 10:00am PT).
- Questionnaire: read-only shared; Alex to flag priority items for us to answer.

Thanks —
Marissa
